another_move.error: another move into a site's limits is running; nothing was changed

build.error: panel/agent build mismatch (panel aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa, agent unknown); finish the paired upgrade before moving a site into its limits

kept_earlier.error: an earlier move of site 7 could not be put back completely; its page names each program left and the next step. Nothing new was moved until that is settled

site_busy.error: the site is being changed right now (for example deleted); nothing was moved. Read its page again in a minute

update_finishing.error: the panel's update is installed, but its last step, turning automatic certificate renewal (Certbot) back on, has not finished; nothing was moved. The release recovery repeats that step by itself (sudo journalctl -u celikpanel-release-recovery.service); move the site once it has finished

update_running.error: the panel's update is in progress; nothing was moved. Move the site after the update has finished

update_unreadable.error: a record of the panel's update could not be read, so it is not known whether an update is in progress; nothing was moved. The Agent's journal names the file; an update request's record stops counting by itself 31 minutes after it last changed
